privacy: Privacy: in demo mode nothing leaves your device. When the assistant is live, your questions are sent to Google’s Gemini API. Please do not enter personal data.

who.question: Who is Ahmadreza?
who.answer: Ahmadreza Taheri works in IT, in Germany. He is currently doing an apprenticeship as an IT specialist for system integration (Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration) at the Stadtverwaltung Trier. His focus is networks and Linux.

skills.question: What skills does he have?
skills.answer: This website lists three areas. Networks: TCP/IP, subnetting, DNS and DHCP, firewall rules, Wi-Fi. Systems: Linux, the shell, Windows clients, users and permissions. Support: structured troubleshooting, tickets, documentation, hardware. He does not state a level.

path.question: What is his background?
path.answer: He is doing a dual apprenticeship as an IT specialist for system integration, at the Stadtverwaltung Trier and in vocational school. Earlier stations are not on the website yet, so I cannot say anything about them.

site.question: What does this website show?
site.answer: 80 years of computing history in seven eras, from ENIAC to the cloud. Each era has a puzzle and explains a foundation that still holds today. At the end is this desktop, with programs such as the Terminal, the ticket system and Traceroute. The website is Ahmadreza’s own project.

contact.question: How can I reach him?
contact.answer: The quickest way is email, at {email}.
